source.note: Transcribed from the complete failure summary emitted by the committed GPU wrapper. The immutable failed attempt remains in the recorded remote run directory.

experiment: OEA-Qwen3B AudioCaps checkpoint full Clotho embedding generation

failure.stage: smoke-gate Python entrypoint import, before smoke evidence verification and before model loading

root_cause.analysis: Executing python scripts/verify_oea_smoke_gate.py sets sys.path[0] to the scripts directory. The gate imported scripts.build_official_oea_eval_config without first inserting the repository root, while module-import unit tests implicitly supplied the repository root and did not cover the deployed entrypoint.

changes: Insert the resolved repository root into sys.path before importing the scripts package.
Add a subprocess regression test that executes the exact direct script entrypoint with --help.
remediation.result_impact: None. The failure occurred before model loading, embedding generation, metric computation, or any modification of candidate/query sets.
